statements.status_notes: This advisory affects github.com/google/cel-go versions 0.22.0 through 0.28.1 and is fixed in 0.29.0 (see https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gcjh-h69q-9w9g). The Calico binaries use cel-go 0.29.2, which includes the fix. In addition, the vulnerable path requires ext.NativeTypes with ext.ParseStructTag, and the calico binary contains neither the NativeTypes, ParseStructTag, fieldNameByTag, nor newNativeTypes symbols (go tool nm), so the vulnerable code is not present.
